plainTranslation:
This person may hit a nerve before either of you knows where the nerve is. It could be their tone, their timing, the way they push, the way they do not back off, or the way they seem to move on before you are ready. Something about them can make your feelings rise quickly.

There may also be real chemistry here, which makes the whole thing more confusing. You can feel pulled toward someone and still feel irritated by them. You can want them close and also want them to stop doing exactly what they are doing. That does not mean the connection is fake. It means the same person who wakes up your desire can also wake up your defenses.

When this works, it can bring things to the surface that needed to be said. You may stop pretending something does not bother you. They may stop letting things slide. The relationship may have a way of forcing honesty, even when neither person planned on being that honest.

The problem is when the friction becomes the main way you stay connected. If things only feel alive when someone is upset, the relationship can start to confuse tension with intimacy. You poke, they react. They push, you defend. After a while, both people are tired, but neither one knows how to get close without lighting something up first.

Catch the small thing while it is still small. Not every feeling needs to become a fight. This connection works better when both people learn how to pause before trying to win the moment.
